$comment: G6-6 (specification 16, 10.6): project-specific values that remain in the framework's reusable code. All of them are test material of the framework's own checks (hosting adapters, release gate, release dry run, portability message text); none is a rule. A ratchet: max can be lowered, never raised; an entry that matches nothing fails check:project. The industry adapters, the development tools (self-tests) and the fixture projects are not scanned (see frameworkReusableFiles in checks/project.mjs); lib/purity.mjs and checks/project.mjs name the forbidden values by design.

allow.reason: The hosting fixture writes a minimal static site; its shared files carry the delivery contract's conventional names. Test material for the adapters, not a rule of the adapters.
Negative cases tamper with the staged site by its conventional file names (a delivered file altered, a credential-shaped string added, the stylesheet requested). Test material, not adapter behaviour.
Text of a measured-finding message that names a hero preload; the finding is emitted only for a project that declares a hero preload (markup.heroPreloadPattern). Message text, not a rule.

Test material of the release gate: case names and reserved test hosts that carry the ancestry of the first project (an approval id in a case title, a reserved fixture host, a hosted-elsewhere image). They exercise the gate and decide nothing in it.
